prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent animation atlas for a historical maritime RPG. Image 1 is the FULL-BODY costume and boots reference from the character's current street walk. Image 2 is the FACE AND HAIRSTYLE identity reference. Create a NEW sheet with the requested actions; preserve this exact adult person's face, hair, body proportions, costume colors, accessories, garment lengths and footwear. Detailed realistic hand-painted game illustration, consistent identity throughout, not chibi. All equipment secured at waist, any sword SHEATHED throughout; empty hands for movement and gestures. Props must remain attached to the belt or genuinely held by fingers. No floating props. Every full figure including hair, fingers, feet and cloth fits wholly inside its own equal-sized cell with generous clear gutters. No duplicate extra people, grid lines, borders, labels, lettering, ground shadows, floor or background gradients. The entire background outside every silhouette must be truly transparent with actual ALPHA ZERO, not white or gray partly-transparent haze. Do not crop heads, raised hands or boots. Do not change camera zoom or figure scale between frames. EXACTLY 8 distinct full-body RUN CYCLE frames, a STRICT 4 columns x 2 rows grid on a landscape 1536x1024 canvas. All figures face RIGHT in consistent side-three-quarter view. Frame order left to right then next row: left-foot forward contact, left-leg compression, left-foot push-off with right knee forward, airborne flight, right-foot forward contact, right-leg compression, right-foot push-off with left knee forward, airborne flight. Arms pump in opposition to legs, natural relaxed five-digit hands, body leans forward modestly, coat and hair follow movement. Show clear alternating left/right strides, not walking poses. No in-place spinning, weapons in hands or acrobatic leaps.
